brands.name: Misfit
brands.short_description: Australian indie surfboard brand — progressive shortboards, twins, fishes, and team-rider signature models from Brookvale.

models.name: Beach Burn
models.description: Part of our 2017 ‘Modern Cloud Control 2’ Collection with a continued progressive design approach to some favored retrospective board designs, the ‘BEACH BURN’ is the round tail, almost “winter twinny” version of the ‘BEACH CLOUD’ twin keel fish. The simple addition of the round tail enables better hold and positioning in steeper or hollow faces, but it also adds more curve through back half of board to maneuver in pocket and pivot effortlessly rail to rail. This girl has subtle singles the whole way through the bottom, which just adds to the speed and trim in down the line or bigger waves, and we’ve also pulled the rail line down, but kept a flat deck panel, which keeps volume in the board but gives more bite when its biting back. Fundamentally this baby is focused on fluidity, glide and flow. She’s every part still a twinny, but we’ve added a rear trailer plug so you can ride with a more upright twinny set + trailer fin. In smaller conditions you can just rip it out, but the “twin + one” setup has the Joy Division levels of “control” and drive characteristics of a thruster but is lively, free and fast like a twinny fish. *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Beach Cloud
models.description: The second of our ‘Modern Cloud Control’ Collection with an overall design emphasis on free-flowing, progressive shapes, the ‘BEACH CLOUD’ is a modern take on a classic twin fin feel. As the name suggests, it has the same gaseous qualities as early evening Chanel perfume, late-night sea fog and loud sneezes at dusk. Like traditional twinnys, the board has as a fuller nose and outline but is curvier in the tail, especially behind the fins, as we designed this board with modern surfy surf in mind. It has other more contemporary elements in rail shape, rocker and foil but we’ve stayed true to the speed, flow and highline attributes of classic twin fin approach. The version pictured here is our small to mid-range version with modern slight doubles to vee bottom but we do also make a longer line version with a traditional single concave bottom and more upright fin design for down-the-line, top-to-bottom approach. If you desire this effervescent creature just ask for the “Hilly Special”… *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Beach Metall
models.description: Part of our 2018 ‘Modern Cloud Control 3’ Collection, the ‘BEACH METALL’ reflects our continued desire to advance performance ‘twin fins’, with this model being the most contemporary, and damn lively one to date. We’ve straightened the rail line from mid point to flyer providing even more drive. The flyer, or wing then breaks the rail line for release and turn-ability. The rails and overall foil is refined from nose to tail to let the water flow over board with minimal restriction, also giving the board incredible hold and control. It has a medium nose lift, but is quite flat out the tail, encouraging masses of planning speed. Slight singles through entry for paddle, blended into doubles under your feet for controlled lift, then mucho vee out the tail, so this baby sings rail-to-rail and off the toppers, while maintaining giant highline pumpo ability like our other more “traditional” twin fin models. It is a pure, unadulterated redux of classic flyer swallow twinny based around a more up-right style fin design. No trailing fin required here mam. We have also developed it with the new FUTURES 'LIGHT' plugs, as part of their limited initial roll out. These plugs are lighter, and by construction of fibreglass and carbon, they are stronger, making them perfección for a mod twin fin design. *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Beach Metall Rnd
models.description: Released in our 2018 ‘Modern Cloud Control 3’ Collection, the original flyer swallow ‘BEACH METALL’ reflected our desire to continue advancing ‘performance’ twin fins. In the winter of 2019, we introduced it’s round (RND) tail sister model to further facilitate the same contemporary twin fin approach but this time in far juicier conditions. The flyer has been replaced with a tight round tail that gradually draws down from an accented wide point, creating an aesthetically pleasing no-break outline that surfs just as it appears - it drives, it holds, it loves the tub, and it’s so fluent and smooth rail-to-rail. We have kept the same low/ medium rails and overall refined foil to let the water flow over the board with minimal restriction, which coupled with the round tail gives the board incredible hold and control. It has the same medium nose lift, and again is quite flat out the tail, encouraging masses of planning speed. Slight singles through entry to encourage paddle-ability, blended into single doubles between your feet for control and stability, then a slight flat out the tail gives this baby controlled release. As with its brother we have based the board around a more up-right style fin design. Still no trailing fin required here, BUT you could add some channels if your intention is to tackle whatever Mother Nature’s big bosoms may throw at you. Maybe even look at adding an inch or two in length, and what the heck, why not go all murdered out like this midnight special… *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Bull Dove
models.description: The ‘BULL DOVE’ is our NEW 2019 team-plug performance shortboard. In fact it’s the most “HP” blade we’ve developed since the release of our long-time favoured team shorty, the ‘PROFORM’, and just like it’s predecessor, this model is designed for all out ATTACK. The name suggests it all; a raging ‘bull’, but perfectly tamed by timeless shortboard design and clean / ‘pure’ lines, hence the ‘dove’ part of the title. Well, that and the fact that we wanted to pay homage to our newest powerhouse family member and model test pilot, Fraser Dovell. Now some tech talk… the board harnesses a straight single concave from nose to tail, deepest between the feet, which gives controlled lift, with a wild amount of speed, sensitivity and drive. A continues medium rocker coupled with a slight hip and our delicious new curved round square tail makes it silky smooth rail-to-rail but capable of hyper quick and more responsive directional changes. All this blended with a slightly fuller rail and marginally wider plan-shape makes it the ultimate “modern” shortboard, one that works for your aspiring grom dom through to your seasoned nooner producer. She’s just a pretty pretty board, one that many are already calling “the best shorty we have ever made”… Stock board includes team-light blank, s-cloth deck, innegra tail patches, plus option of 3 x model decal colours.

models.name: Bull Dove 2
models.description: The globally travelled, highly rated ‘ BULL DOVE’ returns after much anticipation. The name still suggests it all; a raging “bull”, but perfectly tamed by timeless shortboard design and clean, pure lines, hence the “dove” part of the title. Well, that and the fact that we wanted to pay homage to our powerhouse model signatory, Fraser Dovell. Since the conception of the BD, Fraser has literally travelled the globe, most notably around his participation in the Award-Winning surf films, ‘ A Corner of the Earth’ and ‘ Kamchatka’ . This opportunity has allowed him to develop the original 2019 shape to where it is today: a more versatile, more rideable workhorse, but with NO less performance. How?! There are 4 key updates; i- the board now possesses an even deeper single concave from nose to tail, deepest between the feet, which gives controlled lift, with a wild amount of speed, sensitivity, and drive. ii- this is harnessed by a slight reduction in entry rocker, also assisting with paddle power, but overall, the board has a medium rocker suitable for any aspiring grom dom through to your seasoned nooner producer. iii- a widening of the nose and tail, which not only creates a straighter rail line, giving the board more drive and speed, but it also widens the overall the plan-shape making it more forgiving and ride-able. All this combined with the signature curved round square tail makes for a silky-smooth rail-to-rail board, capable of hyper-quick and ultra-responsive directional changes. iv- lastly, the BD2 has a slightly fuller rail, again promoting rideability but when combined with the above changes preserves the immersive performance the BD is known for. The BULL DOVE 2 is the ultimate “modern” shortboard, pretty and predictable at a glance, perfectly blended for versatility, our go-to for all levels of high-performance surfing. Again, many are already calling this “ the best shorty we have ever made ”. * Model available in round square and round tail variants.

models.name: Da Grom
models.description: The ‘DINGO BANDIDO’ was the first signature creation of the enigmatic Otis Hope Carey. Co-designed with Otis, this model is built for individuals that desire to surf like him – vertical, progressive and almost always in the air, unlike a Zeppelin which is only sometimes in the air. A wider nose and tail draws the rail line out making it more parallel to create maximum drive, also unlike a Zeppelin which sort of just glides around in the air. Drive and overall speed is also achieved from a deep single concave throughout the whole bottom of the board. A fairly flat rocker gives the board paddle power and speed, but increased flip in the 8” crescent tail allows for boggle loads of release. Maybe say “DINGO BANDIDO” at your local grocery store for a bonus look of utter confusion.

models.name: Dead Beatsled
models.description: The ‘DEAD BEAT SLED’ is yet another model of board that has three words in its name. This trifecta of semantics was originally conceived by our old pal Mickey Mandrusiak of ‘DEAD BEAT BAND’ and ‘BLEACH GIRLS’ when he requested we add a single-fin box to our best selling model, the DOPE MACHINE. Despite slight adjustments to concaves and bottom curves, fundamentally the two boards are the same in outline and plan-shape, but where the rear fin plug would be we’ve added an 8” box allowing the board to be ridden as a single fin or quad. Pictured here is the model in original diamond tail but of recent times we’ve moved toward a round or area pin, which blends nicely with the single fin setup, especially if your desire is to ride her in some juice, but hey, you ride her how you want, we’re very accommodating folks round here.

models.name: Diamond Dancer
models.description: The first of our 2016 ‘Modern Cloud Control’ Collection with an overall design emphasis on free-flowing, progressive shapes, the ‘DIAMOND DANCER’ is the highly anticipated follow up model to the cult classic ‘MERMAID KILLER’. The DIAMOND DANCER displays our unique “Feeder” channel, running from the nose (minimal) to tail (more pronounced) to project water through the bottom of the board at high velocity. Additionally, there is a slight concave either side of the feeder, which combined gives the board incredible lift and a sensation of floating on top of the water (like that scene from Gladiator when big Russ kicks the bucket and floats over tall grass but in the case water and far from a near death experience, quite the opposite…) The rails are a forgiving medium profile with a slight continuous edge underneath, which gives the board hold, yet incredible directional control and sensitivity. The outline is a curvier take on the MK with approx. 1” more width yet a narrower nose profile, which gives an elliptical outline curve, what does that mean? Smoother transitions and better in-the-pocket control. This, combined with a single flyer and favoured diamond tail, also lends itself to smaller wave conditions, but overall this board is incredibly versatile in anything up to 5-6ft, it enables phenomenal free flowing rail-to-rail transitions, tight turning arcs and MAXIMUS directional control.

models.name: Diamond Dancer 2
models.description: Part of our 2017 ‘Modern Cloud Control 2’ Collection with a continued design emphasis on free-flowing and progressive shapes, the ‘DIAMOND DANCER 2’ is the shortboard, or refined nose profile version of the original snub nose ‘DIAMOND DANCER’. The most noticeable difference between the DD and DD2 is the nose outline, which was inspired by Otis Carey’s desire to ride a shortboard variation of the DD. Consequently, the length of board had to increase to allow for this change, which gave the outline more curve, allowing for more critical positioning and control in the pocket, and a more “shortboard” feel through a wider range of wave conditions. This is also achieved through a combination of other key design elements, a slightly more pronounced flyer, which breaks the rail line and allows for tighter turning arcs, a reduction in rail thickness to aid in hold and responsiveness. Increased nose rocker to aid positioning and transitions, plus we have accented or slightly deepened the quad/ feeder channel, especially around the fin area to encourage incredible water projection out the tail. This board is the evolution of years of design and research in planning hulls, channels, parallel outlines, water displacement and timeless surfboard design. It’s the 3rd generation model of Otis’s, again reflecting his irreverent approach to surfing and continued drive to reach new heights in wav jumping (pun intended). *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Diamond Dancer 3
models.description: Part of our 2018 ‘Modern Cloud Control 3’ Collection, the ‘DIAMOND DANCER 3’ is our most conventional version of the Diamond Dancer Series yet. The most significant change from its predecessor is the overall outline; it bears similar nose width to the DD2, which aids in paddle power, but we have moved the flyer of the DD2 to a pronounced hip, which allows for a smoother more controlled turning arc. The diamond tail of the DD2 has also moved to a round square for a more “shortboard” look and feel. Overall rocker of the board has remained similar, but we have significantly increased nose lift to offset a more refined nose profile and aid in positioning and transitions. Rail shape has also been refined to increase control and responsiveness. And what has remained true, and what is the link of the entire DD range is our signature ‘quad-feeder’ channel. Given the objective of making this version more conventional, we have reduced depth and slightly widened the channel, which reduces lift and encourages greater wave connection, while maintaining the phenomenal speed that the channel generates. Again, this board is the evolution of years of design and research in planning hulls, channels, outlines, water displacement and control, and timeless surfboard design.

models.name: Dingo Bandido
models.description: The ‘DINGO BANDIDO’ was the first signature creation of the enigmatic Otis Hope Carey. Co-designed with Otis, this model is built for individuals that desire to surf like him – vertical, progressive and almost always in the air, unlike a Zeppelin which is only sometimes in the air. A wider nose and tail draws the rail line out making it more parallel to create maximum drive, also unlike a Zeppelin which sort of just glides around in the air. Drive and overall speed is also achieved from a deep single concave throughout the whole bottom of the board. A fairly flat rocker gives the board paddle power and speed, but increased flip in the 8” crescent tail allows for boggle loads of release. Maybe say “DINGO BANDIDO” at your local grocery store for a bonus look of utter confusion.

models.name: Dope Machine
models.description: Unrivalled, unprecedented, pure fun; the ‘DOPE MACHINE’ is the first of our collaboration series with long time ‘MAD MINDS’ Advocate George Henderson of ‘A DEAD COFFIN CLUB’. Fundamentally, it is a combination of a classic high wide point fun-board, almost reminiscent of a 70’s single fin spawned with a modern proggy fish or hybrid. The signature diamond tail gives the board a shorter rail line, so the water breaks earlier which creates an early pivot point for a wildly responsive, tighter turning board that also allows for positioning in more critical parts of a wave. The rail volume is reduced slightly, rocker increased and bottom concave charged up for damn a lively ride. True to name, the “DOPE MACHINE” is one TUFF customer. It’s a little known fact that before the invention of transparent, high-impact polycarbonate, the L.A.P.D used DOPE MACHINE’s as riot shields during the ‘big bruise up of ‘88’. *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Drib
models.description: Hingy's got a Signature Model. I reckon most surfers dream of having a surfboard model bearing their name, but very few get to realize it. In recent years we've endeavoured to bring more of our fam into the design suite to create boards they are proud to call theirs and ones that reflect their approach to surfing. Sunshine Coast's son KAI HING is the newest to join these ranks, and his step-down model is him to a tee. Like him, It's as fast, free, and fun as they come, so fittingly we've called it ' DRIB ' (BIRD backwards). Now it bears all the features you want in your all-out shorty but packed into a shorter/ wider outline designed to be ridden min. 2" shorter than what was once your conventional short-board. An accented forward-placed wide point and lower entry rocker means you're in and on your feet early with instant speed and acceleration. This curvy and shorter outline also positions beautifully in steeper faces and the tub, which longer boards can sometimes feel more difficult to manoeuvre. Subtle vee combined with softer bottom rails in the entry also enables a more forgiving approach to steeper sections and helps initiate smoother transitions between rails. From there, the bottom shape is a combination of subtle single to double concave that results in a stable yet super responsive board that loves to be pushed hard. This all draws into a tighter round tail with slight lift in the exit rocker that allows explosive release and incredible directional control. Where this shape is truly unique is its range; it's incredibly fun on mid to head-high days, but she's a darn guided missile in juicier conditions, which makes this model the ultimate travel companion and versatile daily driver that suits almost all surfers, in almost all conditions.

models.name: Eraser Head
models.description: Our beloved Guadeloupean National Tito LaVole has his first M/SF/T Signature model, aptly named 'ERASER HEAD' , an ode to David Lynch's 1977 horror film of the same name. This board has been nearly 2 years in development and has taken many turns in design. It started as a round tail twin fin with flyers and a deep quad channel. It is now a thumby round square tri-quad with a hip and no channel. But Tito's vision, combined with years of research and development, has resulted in a board that possesses lightning-fast speed, incredible responsiveness, and progressive surfing potential, while maintaining fun, rideability and forgiveness. In many ways, Eraser Head is the continuation of our ‘ Modern Cloud Control’/ ‘Diamond Dancer ’ Series, a design emphasis on intuitive, free-flowing, progressive, high performance surfboard design. Tech talk; OUTLINE: The board features a clean, flowing outline starting with the feature snub nose, which positions in the wave beautifully, promotes effortless transitions and allows user to ride shorter board lengths. Greenough claims the snub is the “most functional high performance nose shape”. This then carries into a wider, almost parallel outline into a subtle hip near the fin area, creating a tighter turning potential. The hip is blended into a rounded square tail, offering stability, drive, and a perfect platform for landing airs. DECK/ RAILS/ FOIL: Most of this board’s volume is distributed close to the stringer, along the centre panel, enhancing paddling and cushioning for aerial manoeuvres. The deck smoothly transitions to a medium-forgiving rail offering stability and control. This finishes out in a refined tail offering heightened sensitivity and responsiveness under your back foot. BOTTOM CURVES: Beneath the surface, a slight rolled vee in the entry aids water penetration and displacement, meaning no catching when dropping in or climbing the face. A shallow single concave under the front foot promotes speed by propelling water through the feet, which then blends into a slight double concave for subtle lift, then to flat out of the tail for smooth transitions and controlled release. ROCKER: A medium nose rocker offers solid paddle power and reduces catching during big hacks or airs. Low tail rocker ensures exceptional drive, balanced by this single-to-double-to-flat bottom curve for seamless transitions. The Eraser Head is a wonderful blend of timeless design and progressive engineering, which creates effortless and intuitive rideability and the highest of performance surfing potential. This is the board for NOW. Model comes standard as a tri/ quad setup. *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Fang
models.description: Lock and load Raoul Duke, the ‘FANG’ is our step up hybrid “small board” model. What the heck is that you ask? Is it Lynard Skynard playing a hologram show in 2025? Close. It’s the refined, pinny sister model to our original small board hybrid the ‘FLAIR’ designed for waves in the 4 – 8ft range while maintaining maneuverability and critical tube riding ability. It has a single concave running from nose to back fins, with the same rounded pin template as our semi-guns to demonstrate to the large wave that you is the true BUBBA! If you’re one that craves the caves, this model is destined for you. Maybe even throw a confederate flag on the hood for maximum intimidation.

models.name: Fang Variation
models.description: Another FANG means another pun, so don’t’ worry boss, you’ll fangk me later. What’s also a tad comical is that the ‘FANG VARIATION’ is based off a step up model given its design fundamentals being suited to that of a mid-range wave board, but the original plan-shape was drawn from the ‘FANG’ and like the fang’s ability to position itself in critical parts of the wave, this board is also designed to hug the curve but surf across a wider range of conditions and overall be more playful. Fundamentally the board carries a lot more width than its predecessor, it also runs a different bottom curve, which gives the board lift, pivot and release in smaller conditions. This board is a lot of fun, it surfs how you imagine it would, effortless rail-to-rail, glide but hold and control when it counts. It comes as no surprise that everyone is fighting tooth and nail for a turn of this ‘dank prong of dentition’.

models.name: Fungzetti
models.description: Mitch Coleborn is a surfer's surfer. His credibility amongst the surfing fraternity's core has been defined by his game-changing appearances in surf films like Modern Collective, Cluster, BS! and Stranger Than Fiction. His power & aggression, yet poise embodies surfing's definition from other board sports. His extensive knowledge and understanding of board design has also made him a force. Since Coleborn’s addition to the family, we have been dialing his “everyday shortboard”, and after nearly 18 months of development, his first M/SF/T signature model is here ~ FUNGZETTI . ‘ A surfer’s surfer. A surfer’s surfboard.’ This board is high-end European luxury supercar energy in surfboard form. The plan-shape inspiration came from our previous team favoured shorty & performance workhorse, the BULL DOVE . Where this board differs is in design qualities that Mitch has fine-tuned over his career. Most notably the distribution or disguising of foam. Mitch wanted the board to maintain volume, but without a full or boxy rail. So, we blended the volume that modern surfers are accustomed to with sensitive or hyper responsive rails, which resulted in a more domed deck than any of our shortboards. That thickness along the stringer means retained volume for paddle power and a more forgiving ride, but the rails are medium to low for sensitivity and reactive rail feel. The other notable update from the bull dove, and one that Mitch has become synonymous for, is shortboards with slightly wider outlines. And we need to stress, it’s only slight, this board is amped up performance machinery. So, let’s refer to this width as “curve”, which is continuous from nose to tail, with slightly more width up front, which aids in paddle and forward momentum. This is then blended into what is our proven team mainstay round square tail, and given seasonal relevance of this release, a swallow tail option. In fact, this is the first time we have released one model with two tail shapes from the get-go. And to help those who may be confused, the round square is your every dayer, the swallow is going to excel in grovel. And we have designed the swallow to be ridden 1” shorter and 1/8 wider for that reason. To the bottom, and no surprises, this baby is a single concave from nose to tail cause she is all about wearing speedos. This concave is accented between the feet, which works to flatten the rocker for more controlled drive. Fin placements are also adjusted to offset drive and lift, enabling incredible release and projection out the tail. The last but all-important design feature is the rocker, which is a medium to continuous rocker with the apex close to the fin area for early and fast acceleration, which is great for generating speed quickly as well as improved carry over fatter sections. This is a board that has been designed by one of the best free surfers of our generation, but it actually transitions perfectly and accommodates your everyday surfer. She’s a beautifully balanced board, offset in all the right areas to give maximum performance and forgiveness.

models.name: G W O R
models.description: G W O R ~ as in ‘gwor did you see that?!”… well, kind of, we just wanted a model & name reminiscent of the power and passion of the early 80s. And it just so happens that in the same year (1984) Gonz featured on the cover of ‘Thrasher’ Magazine performing a “beanplant”, Occy burst on to the world surfing scene soaring to the top of the ASP ratings. So one might say we made a baby out of gonz and occy… ewww! But no denying it, these guys, and this era inspired the latest in our ‘Contemporary-Retrospective’ Collection. The board has a flat deck, with forward thickness for float + paddle power. Full, slight chine low-apex rails with period honouring hard edge from nose to tail for drive + edge control. Relaxed entry rocker makes it quick off mark. Rolled vee in nose (to offset flatter rocker), in to flat under front foot, in to a belly channel through mid and vee out tail promotes both speed + release. A wider forward outline for paddle-ability, in to a straighter rail line through mid for drive, with hips for release + tighter turning arcs, and a wider, stable round square tail for planing speed. It’s all topped off with a wedged beak nose, 6oz deck, 80s inspired decals, and guaranteed hell-of-a-good time.

models.name: Gun
models.description: The late Hunter. S. Thompson used to surround himself with all sorts of guns because, “if people believe they’re going to be shot, they might stay away.” While Thompson was a prolific journalist, he was also a paranoid maniac. So rather than amassing a vast array of street heaters, we’ve stuck with just two variations of the ‘GUN’ or step up series boards. The first weapon in our arsenal is that of a classic semi-gun or extension of your normal board with slight increases in standard dimensions to paddle you in to big days at your home break or the odd shoot over to Grajagan. The second, and arguably more exciting to us right now are high-volume guns for outer banks, deep reefs and big wave spots across the Pacific. As the name suggests, high volume guns carry exaggerated volume for incredible paddle power but also allow riders to surf spots once only surfed on massive lengths or ski-assisted tow boards. This is no doubt a specialty category and one that we work very intimately with the aspiring hellman on each board.

models.name: Longus
models.description: This model was originally planned to be called the LONG CLOUD, derived from its extended length on base model the BEACH CLOUD. But long cloud felt more like the name of a weather pattern. It’s not like “warm day” is a sexy name for pair of pants, long cloud wasn’t sexy enough either. So, we landed on ‘ LONGUS’ , derived from the Greek word "Longos", which simply means ‘long’ or ‘a long structure’. Fitting, as the model is available between 6'4 and 8'0 as stock sizes, but we can make right up to, ready for it.... 11’0!!! The board itself is everything you want it to be. It’s an aesthetically pleasing mid-length twin that has a tonne of rideability because it is a classic plan-shape re-designed by an experienced 'high-performance' shaper. As he does in almost every retrospective shape, head shaper Dave disguises performance in classic shapes and outlines, and the Longus is no exception. The model is a responsive, free, and incredibly fast board that allows riders to drive hard off the bottom, trim with ease, and draw effortless lines. Tech talk ; RAILS /FOIL: The board maintains a generous amount of foam throughout the centre panel of the board, which tapers off to a foiled down yet forgiving rail. This equates to hold and response without being too critical. BOTTOM CURVES: The entry is rolled vee, almost dishy, which helps cut through and displace water, meaning no catching when dropping in or climbing the face. That carries into a very slight single that provides a touch of lift and carry under your front feet, then returning to a slight double concave to vee, which promotes release and allows for effortless rail-to-rail transitions. ROCKER: Although fairly flat, the board has a continual rocker accented in the nose and tail, again to lifting the nose out of the water and allowing for more release and turn-ability. OUTLINE: The outline is a fuller, traditional mid-length fish that tapers into a slightly narrower tail with deep swallow creating a straighter rail line that has incredible drive and hold. The combination of rail length, pinched rails and bottom contours all add up to a beautiful blend of hold, flow and release, all packaged a in a high-end, no expense spared showpiece yet everyday board.

models.name: Magic Mule
models.description: The ‘MAGIC MULE’, your all round workhorse, initially designed as the big brother to the THRUSTER SPACE DOLPHIN; this model is built with maximum fun, forgiveness and versatility in mind. One Aztec priest told me that this here “La Mula Magica” carries more width through the nose and tail, more thickness through the foil and has a slightly more toned down continuous single concave than it’s younger sibling, all of which resulting in a much more forgiving shortboard that goes wonderfully in almost all conditions. This mystical steed serves as a great intermediate level shortboard, but don’t assume it’s just that, throw a round tail on her and she’ll make a splendid summer shorty suitable for any shred Rey (*King in Spanish).

models.name: Mermaid Killer
models.description: The second signature model and next generation shape of Otis Carey’s, the ‘MERMAID KILLER’. As you may have realized, Otis has an insatiable appetite for co-designing unreal, unbeatable and unapologetic sleds. This board is all about heightened speed and responsiveness allowing for progressive modern surfing through an ultra short and refined shape. Foam is redistributed through a parallel outline and unique curves allowing for a reduction in boards physical size compared to conventional shortboard design. The board has a low nose rocker for paddle power but single concave through the entry giving the nose lift from the initial paddle in and take-off. A slight concave then carries through to the tail, which has a single curved channel coupled with a dome swallow for increased control, speed and release. The reduced length and straighter outline then allow for an elevated surfing experience and the ability to be positioned anywhere on the wave. If you’re still reading this, would a mermaid have a fish head and human legs? Or would it be the other way around?

models.name: Neo Speed Egg
models.description: Although never released, we have been playing with this model for over 10 years. So it's old in design, but new (neo) from us. It is also the base planshape of our upcoming mid-length 'softboard' (more on that to come...). So here it finally is, the mid-length shape we always seem to circle back to, a classic ‘SPEED EGG’. Now this is far from new in design, the shape was pioneered in California across the 1970s, but like all our retrospective inspired shapes, we have applied contemporary and progressive design to classic board principles. The ‘Neo Speed Egg’ is an all-round design with a relaxed entry rocker for ease of paddle plus a slight lift and a snubbed off nose to reduce catching in critical parts of the wave. The clean “eggy” outline has an accented forward placed wide point for effortless paddle and trim, tapered in to a round, or round pin tail for fluidity, flow and control when it counts. The bottom is a subtle roll vee to double vee combination, with a single fin, or 2+1 fin configuration, all combining to create a speedy all-rounder that flows, glides and planes in a wide range of locations and conditions. This board suits your transitioning surfer, through to your experienced short/ small board rider that wants a flowing, fast mid length board. *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Nu Ravr
models.description: In the words of the great Herbie Fletcher “ when in doubt, paddle out ”. Fundamentally, this is the inspiration behind the ‘NU RAVR’; developed initially as a step-up request of our original single fin model, the ‘NU WAVR’, but by design principle, it’s also in the same category as our ‘high-volume’ guns. Look, the board isn’t for everyone. You got to want to ride length, pin-tails, single fins, vee, but if that’s you, then maan you’re gonna hoot your way to heaven on this. The outline is full Lopez/ Brewer 70’s inspired – wide point forward for ease in paddling and forward positioning, drawn to a wild winged pin. This wing, along with significant vee from entry to tail is going to aid in rail-to-rail transitions and ride-ability, the pin; well it’s to get you piped. The rest is pretty true to period too – foiled with thickness under the chest, but refined in the tail with significant down rail for hold and water-flow. Rocker is flat for drive and flow, with slight nose lift to aid in getting you into the cabins. It’s a “mod” interpretation of a 70’s gun, straight single fin ONLY, built for long points, big bombys and the pipe.

models.name: Nu Wavr
models.description: The ‘NU WAVR’ is our unique “single fin-multi”, another modern interpretation of a retrospective design; drawing from a classic pintail vee bottom single fin but with contemporary inspiration, most notably the option to ride this board as a quad, thruster or single fin, making the board incredibly versatile and dynamic, like a winged cheetah for instance. Overall the outline and plan-shape is about as dreamy clean as a cut throat shave, which allows water to flow around it with no breaks giving the rider a smooth flowing experience and ability to draw effortless lines. Like boards of that era, the board has subtle rolled vee through the entry but then flows into a slight double concave back to vee out the tail. This more modern combination gives the board a graceful rail-to-rail feel perfect for flowing highline pumps and big driving bottom turns. The NU WAVR is everything you dream about in a retrospective board – speed, grace, glide, flow but ultimately it is a single fin designed by a progressive “shortboard” shaper, so the board loves to turn, it can be pushed hard, its sits an amazing line in the barrel and it suits anyone who is looking for a classic single fin feel. Order short for beachies and rip bowls or pinned out and lengthy for points, Mex pipes or Indo growers.

models.name: Proform
models.description: I recently watched the 2010 remake of ‘The Karate Kid’, which I agree is a questionable choice of film from the outset, but furthermore I resigned that it was an absolute awful remake of an original classic, which is the polar opposite of what we have done here. The ‘PROFORM’ is the 98% on Rotten Tomatoes remake of our original ‘Pro-formance’ model. The board still has that incredible F1 feel and responsiveness that you would expect from our original best selling and go-to team blade, but we have updated it with some conventional and slightly more forgiving attribute; most notably a fuller, or more “post 2010” contemporary shortboard outline. Don’t be fooled though, this nooner producer is still a homage to tearing blades of the ‘00’s. We have kept the same continuous rocker with accelerated late kick in tail for flow, drive and release, a dished out concave from entry through tail for added lift, squirt and responsive rail-to-rail power surfing. It has a Double Bay dental surgery clean foil from nose to tail and any excess foam is trimmed off to make this board an extension of your body in good to perfect wave conditions, you’ll no doubt (but with limited guarantee to keep our solicitor happy) experience the best sessions of your life on this board!!

models.name: Shadow Puppet
models.description: This straight up sled doesn’t have too much in common with the subtly subversive Javanese puppet theatre “Wayang Kulit”. I mean on one hand, UNESCO called the Wayang Kulit a, ‘masterpiece of oral and intangible heritage of humanity’, while on the other hand, our ‘SHADOW PUPPET’ was referred to as, “the squash version of our back-catalogue SHADOW model.” We originally worked with Chris “Critter” Salisbury on redesigning a clean wave favourite back in 2013, where Crit wanted a similar outline but a reduction in length for more critical positioning. So, this baby is even more elliptical in the outline than the Shadow, which combined with a squash tail option not only excels in the pocket but has release in all the right parts of the wave. The round tail option then offers extra hold in the barrel but also transitions silky smoothly rail-to-rail. The sexy update to a best selling pocket rocket and a perfect board for a traveling tube bender. In hindsight, if you surf this board in front of a setting sun, you may well resemble the dancing puppet figures of the Javanese Wayang.

models.name: Sinister Kid
models.description: Until now, the most sinister kid was definitely Nelson Muntz. However, it is with great pride that we now announce that there is a new king in town. It all started as the second installment of our collaboration series with George Henderson of ‘A.D.C.C’, the ‘SINISTER KID’ is our new proggy take on a traditional mini simmons. True to its original plan-shape, this board is super flat, with lots of surface area, which hovers over small waves and fat sections. The bottom has a rolled vee through entry into a double concave and vee out tail, allowing the board to pivot and release, sit a high trim line yet be forgiving and stable. The low profile rail shape, fin configuration and overall weight and shape is all modernized to make a radically short, wildly fun summer board for waves under 4ft and a classic running point style board. You can rest easy knowing that there isn’t a more sinister kid than the sinister kid.

models.name: Sk8ey 2.0
models.description: Like all former Hollywood stars, our original best selling skateboard inspired fish, the SK8EY has had some work done to keep her looking relevant and saucy. Anyone familiar with waiting room magazines would know that the ‘SK8EY 2.0’ has had a nose job, some lipo on the bum and an overall tightening of the curves. Her frightening return to stardom was also accompanied by the original flyers, tight swallow, extreme double concave/ vee and now with the option of a 5-fin setup make for an unrestrained 80’s flyer swallow redux. Whether you believe the media or not, it is certain that this is the model for any shortboard guy looking for a wild summer slayer or go-to proggy semi-fish. *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Speed Egg - Diamond Twin
models.description: Our classic NEO ‘SPEED EGG’ now has a spicy sister model, the ‘ SPEED EGG - DIAMOND TWIN ’. And really a “sister” is the best way to describe these board’s fundamental differences – she’s a bit smaller, a bit naughtier and she loves Gaga. But like most siblings, the boards are very similar, with the only real differences being overall length, fin setup and the addition of a subtle diamond tail. The original ‘Neo Speed Egg’ is an all-round design with a relaxed entry rocker for ease of paddle plus a slight lift and a snubbed off nose to reduce catching in critical parts of the wave. The clean “eggy” outline has an accented forward placed wide point for effortless paddle and trim. The OG speed egg bared a round, or round pin tail for fluidity, flow and control. The now diamond tail responds in much the same way, but the points of the diamond accent the rail line, giving it more drive, when then combined with the twin fin configuration allow for effortless release and masses of speed. The bottom shape is the same subtle roll vee to double vee combination, which paired with the change in fin setup to twin, diamond tail + shortening of overall length, create an even livelier all-rounder that flows, glides and positions in a wide range of locations and conditions. Again, this board suits your transitioning surfer, through to your experienced short/ small board rider that wants a fast, flowing, dynamic mid-length. *Note - sprays may vary on listed stock boards. Seek availabilities from our sales team ~ hello@misfitshapes.com

models.name: Suspended Particle
models.description: The ‘SUSPENDED PARTICLE’ is the only “shortboard” to be designed amidst this current post-apocalyptic age. Like any other piece of Cold War technology, this machine is built for flowing, top to bottom progressive surfing in everyday 2 - 6ft conditions. The SUSPENDED PARTICLE has a continuous rocker for linked rail-to-rail surfing, with a medium entry curve, which allows for ease of paddle into waves or all-out guerilla warfare. The nose outline has increased width compared to our other conventional shortboard outlines, which gives more surface and planning area to allow ALL CITIZENS to be carried across fat sections of the wave with ease and stability. This coupled back with a tighter, old favourite “squash” tail makes the outline curvy for high maneuverability in the pocket. This board is the ultimate ‘party in the front and business at the back’, she’s super directional, responsive and holds tight when pushed hard. Since you asked, it is the surfboard equivalent of Che Guevara, Marilyn Munroe and Brian Jones all in one.

models.name: Thruster Space Dolphin
models.description: Still one of the most infamous players on the block, the ‘THRUSTER SPACE DOLPHIN’ is our punt machine for proggy surfing in small to mid-range wave conditions. This model has a deep single concave from nose all the way out through its signature 7” chopped square tail as well as an unmistakable stench of the good times. This tail width and deep concave, coupled with parallel rails and a low entry rocker means masses of drive and acceleration. Clustered fins and a refined tail with plenty of flip then promote release (like the defense lawyers of Steven Avery) for punts, blow tails and fins sars! Want to get high? I’m your guy…

models.name: Truffle Shuffle
models.description: After a long and at times brutal court case, ‘Chunk’ from the Goonies finally pulled down his floral shirt and began designing surfboards. Chunk (aka David George Howell) first designed the ‘TRUFFLE SHUFFLE’ back in 2012 as a step down for our travelling and competing team, but it has continued being a crowd favourite because of its forgiving, versatile yet explosive nature in almost all wave conditions. The board carries a touch extra width in the nose and foam under the chest and front foot, with a forgiving rail shape all compensating for a reduction in board length from refined “pro-form” outline. The entry rocker is flatter, which helps for paddling and flow across fat sections but has double concave and pronounced vee running through the tail, which coupled with a slightly clustered fin set up gives the board incredible pivot and release. In short, the TRUFFLE SHUFFLE is as timeless as any other 1980’s action/ adventure/ comedy.

models.name: Yandina Speedway
models.description: ‘ YANDINA SPEEDWAY’ , the long-awaited, and first signature model of OG M/SF/T family JAKE VINCENT , and who would expect a shape and name anything less representative of the “Vin”. This is QLD, engine culture and hellman spirit all packaged in a model for those that desire to surf like Vin; animated, untamed, progressive and unpredictable. The model bears a lot of similarity to Vin’s previous chariots of choice, the DD2 and DINGO , with a similar wide nose and tail that draw the rail line out making it more parallel to create maximum speed + drive. Lismore levels of speed + lift are also achieved from our proven quad channel bottom developed through our ‘Diamond Dancer’ series, which project out the tail in a similar way to the DD . The tail also harnesses another previously proven element, the domed swallow from the MERMAID KILLER , which in short, promotes speed and release, while maintaining control, especially in a reversed position. Got it yet? Well we’re not even nearly done…. Almost all of this board’s big Vin energy is in its deck and rails. The deck is fully flat, in fact it goes beyond into a subtle concave, which creates a more sensitive surfing feel; as one’s feet are almost closer to the water and fin area. Toward the tail this then moves into a slight double concave for comfort and grip while shuvving and revving. This is all finished off with chimed rails to propel water off the deck and create shapely rails that penetrate the wall of the wav without biting. The last element, which is oh so important, is the 13 hand-drawn decals by the iconic Australian punk artist BEN BROWN that are guaranteed to make this board un-noticeable to none. As one can see she is wild beyond belief, but on a technical level this board is the evolution and next generation of the MK/ DD series, which has been years of design and research in planning hulls, channels, parallel outlines, water displacement and timeless surfboard design.
